9. [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game consists of 7 rounds, with the Ghost providing visions through cards to help the Psychic Mediums identify the suspect, location, and murder weapon.
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mysterium is suitable for 3 players, but the dynamics may change slightly, with the Ghost having more control and the Psychic Mediums needing to work closely together.
